source: https://www.parlament.hu/web/guest/felicitas/api/query/select/patko/patko-queries/kepviselo-helye-apatkoban?page=0 — the query behind the seat map on every MP page (kepviselok_mobil?kepviselo={"id":…}); POST body: the MP id as a JSON string; the per-MP 'ottUl' flag is dropped here
note: 274 seats of the képviselőházi ülésterem as parlament.hu draws them: szektor / sor / szék, szektipus (null | 'p' | 's'), and each seat's outline as an SVG path in parlament.hu's own coordinate space (their Vega view scales it by 0.15 into 300×200). Sector 0 is the ministerial patkó (22 seats: two straight arms of 8 along the centre aisle, joined by an arc of 6). Sectors 1 and 6 are straight blocks where 'sor' runs as columns, row 1 nearest the aisle; sectors 2–5 are concentric arcs. Coordinates: y grows downwards; the Speaker's platform is at the bottom centre, in the mouth of the horseshoe.
